scope: TemporalState two-phase candidate, commit, reset, stable draw identity and jitter sequence
review_checks: Failed preparation returns before modifying pending candidate, token, committed snapshot, epoch or output.
Only the newest successfully prepared candidate token is committed. A reset invalidates pending tokens while preserving increasing token identity.
Jitter and epoch advance on commit. Abandoned viewport or projection changes preserve committed state.
Committed draws are sorted using all four identity fields. Output is produced in the current input order, with duplicate identities rejected.
New and explicitly reset draws use current transform as invalid previous history. Removed draws disappear on commit.
Ordinary camera motion uses the previous committed unjittered camera, while viewport and projection metadata changes start a new history epoch.
